discriminator_questions: Is commanded torque produced at the actuator interface?
Is wheel motion absent because of mechanical restraint or because torque delivery is lost?
Does the control-loop residual affect several actuators coherently?
Is the disturbance axis-selective or common to all IMU outputs?
Is the signature a persistent offset, increased variance, missing samples, or a zero output?
Does an independent attitude reference contradict the IMU measurement?
Do current and delivered-torque channels indicate actuation while only measured speed is inconsistent?
Is the speed response physically absent or merely reported incorrectly?
Are speed validity flags degraded independently of command-execution residuals?
Is a solution present and fresh?
Does the reported attitude change with vehicle motion?
Is disagreement with propagated attitude approximately constant or time-frozen?
Is the whole vector unavailable or only one sensing cell degraded?
Are outputs clipped at a limit while validity remains asserted?
Is the observed vector norm/direction physically consistent with illumination geometry?
Is generation reduced, storage unavailable, or demand increased?
Does the loss affect the whole bus or a commanded PDU branch?
Do SOC, net-power and command-execution residuals agree on the same mechanism?
Does heater command disagree with actual heater state?
Is unexpected heat input localized to a node?
Is heat rejection reduced despite radiator command and suitable boundary conditions?
Is data absent at generation, storage, transmission, or link delivery?
Are commands asserted and permitted at the affected boundary?
Do buffer-flow and requested-versus-delivered rates localize the loss?
Is propellant loss present outside commanded burns?
Does a commanded burn produce zero thrust or reduced thrust?
Do fuel-flow and delivered-thrust residuals distinguish ignition from nozzle restriction?

claim_boundary: Confusion sets and discriminator questions are review-required engineering candidates derived from the synthetic dataset taxonomy. They are not confirmed causal rules, calibrated thresholds, or runtime voting evidence.
